# Instance array carrier void invocation

This owned fixture pairs one method-scoped Object formal array with an invariant
public static member interface. A constructor invokes the original public
instance provider, preserving its receiver, every array store and callback,
partial writes, and exact failure identity. Frozen external callers cover direct
construction, a factory, reflection and method handles. Future provider and
payload subclasses are compiled only in the observer. The source and dependency
layouts retain every original class, member, Code role and generic contract.
The runner qualifies wrong programs and unchanged-Code Signature mutations before
calling NeverD, then compiles every emitted Java unit and reruns the same observer.
